QPC deltas are retained independently; no shared cross-process monotonic origin was recorded. The UTC comparisons show approximately 1959 ms margin; they are not a direct shared-QPC boundary proof.

readProgressInference.readOperationCheck: 318 = 165 + 3 * 51; corroborates prefix inference but does not label individual OS I/O operations
readProgressInference.interpretation: Aggregate read-counter progression exactly matches ordered manifest prefixes after a baseline independently reconciled against both successful control slots. This supports ongoing/incomplete Invoke-ReadSet work at termination, rather than sole delay in final whole-response Encode-Value or pipe write. No per-path I/O trace or script call stack was retained, so exact per-file completion and individual chain/read/base64 substage costs remain inference, not directly observed events.
limitations: GetProcessIoCounters is aggregate process I/O and includes startup and request transport.
The baseline is an observed arithmetic correspondence, not a labeled I/O source.
Sample windows bracket counter queries; sample start is not the exact read timestamp.
This does not separate disk latency, chain identity checks, PowerShell execution, allocation/base64, CPU scheduling or GC.
No general capacity or unobserved-runtime performance guarantee follows.
